contract: extern C void launch_kernel(float* q, float* k, float* v, float* o, int batch, int heads, int seq, int head_dim, float scale)

arguments.name: scale
arguments.description: scaling factor applied to QK^T before softmax

contract_schema.semantics:
Causal scaled dot-product attention forward pass.

Tensor layout: Q, K, V, O are [batch, heads, seq, head_dim] contiguous row-major.

For each b in [0,batch), h in [0,heads), i in [0,seq):
  For each j in [0,i] (j <= i ONLY): score(i,j) = sum_d(Q[b,h,i,d] * K[b,h,j,d]) * scale
  For j > i: score(i,j) = -infinity (masked, zero contribution)
  m_i = max_{j <= i} score(i,j)
  For j <= i: p(i,j) = exp(score(i,j) - m_i) / sum_{t <= i} exp(score(i,t) - m_i)
  For j > i: p(i,j) = 0
  For each d: O[b,h,i,d] = sum_{j <= i} p(i,j) * V[b,h,j,d]

Special cases:
  i = 0: only key 0 is visible, output depends only on V[...,0,:]
  i = seq-1: all keys are visible (upper triangular mask)

Numerical stability: always subtract row maximum before exponentiation in softmax.
MASKING: j > i positions MUST NOT contribute to output. Use -infinity or equivalent.
